body: English contributor documentation and concise agent workflow guidance are already published in commits 69d246a and 5386db1. The owner requested committing and pushing the remaining changes. The preceding full code/documentation gate passed 255 Rust, 137 JavaScript and 12 Python tests. Concurrent card-layout implementation remains in progress and is outside this completed documentation/data checkpoint. No application behavior or product acceptance was changed by this publication step.
